title: Impact of DNA sequences on DNA 'opening' by the Rad4/XPC nucleotide excision repair complex.
authors: Paul, Debamita; Mu, Hong; Tavakoli, Amirrasoul; Dai, Qing; Chakraborty, Sagnik; He, Chuan; Ansari, Anjum; Broyde, Suse; Min, Jung-Hyun
one_liner_zh: 该文结合MD模拟与荧光实验研究Rad4/XPC对DNA序列依赖性'打开'识别机制，属蛋白质-DNA互作动态机理研究，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合建模。
abstract: Rad4/XPC recognizes diverse DNA lesions to initiate nucleotide excision repair (NER). However, NER propensities among lesions vary widely and repair-resistant lesions are persistent and thus highly mutagenic. Rad4 recognizes repair-proficient lesions by unwinding ('opening') the damaged DNA site. Such 'opening' is also observed on a normal DNA sequence containing consecutive C/G's (CCC/GGG) when tethered to Rad4 to prevent protein diffusion. However, it was unknown if such tethering-facilitated DNA 'opening' could occur on any DNA or if certain structures/sequences would resist being 'opened'. Here, we report that DNA containing alternating C/G's (CGC/GCG) failed to be opened even when tethered; instead, Rad4 bound in a 180 degrees -reversed manner, capping the DNA end. Fluorescence lifetime studies of DNA conformations in solution showed that CCC/GGG exhibits local pre-melting that is absent in CGC/GCG. In MD simulations, CGC/GCG failed to engage Rad4 to promote 'opening' contrary to CCC/GGG. Altogether, our study illustrates how local sequences can impact DNA recognition by Rad4/XPC and how certain DNA sites resist being 'opened' even with Rad4 held at that site indefinitely. The contrast between CCC/GGG and CGC/GCG sequences in Rad4-DNA recognition may help decipher a lesion's mutagenicity in various genomic sequence contexts to explain lesion-determined mutational hot and cold spots.
abstract_zh: Rad4/XPC识别多种DNA损伤以启动核苷酸切除修复（NER）。然而，不同损伤之间的NER倾向差异很大，且修复抗性损伤具有持久性，因此高度致突变。Rad4通过解旋（“打开”）受损DNA位点来识别修复胜任的损伤。这种“打开”现象也在含有连续C/G（CCC/GGG）的正常DNA序列上观察到，当该序列与Rad4连接以防止蛋白质扩散时。然而，尚不清楚这种连接促进的DNA“打开”是否能发生在任何DNA上，或者某些结构/序列是否会抵抗被“打开”。在此，我们报告，含有交替C/G（CGC/GCG）的DNA即使被连接也无法被打开；相反，Rad4以180度反向方式结合，封盖DNA末端。溶液中DNA构象的荧光寿命研究表明，CCC/GGG表现出局部预熔解，而CGC/GCG中则不存在。在分子动力学（MD）模拟中，CGC/GCG未能与Rad4结合以促进“打开”，与CCC/GGG相反。总之，我们的研究阐明了局部序列如何影响Rad4/XPC对DNA的识别，以及某些DNA位点即使在Rad4无限期停留于该位点时也抵抗被“打开”。CCC/GGG与CGC/GCG序列在Rad4-DNA识别中的对比可能有助于解读损伤在不同基因组序列背景下的致突变性，以解释损伤决定的突变热点和冷点。
